blocks: UPSC Toppers 2025 List: 71 in Top 100 Associated with VisionIAS
This year’s result highlights a remarkable achievement:
7 candidates in the Top 10 and 71 candidates in the Top 100 ranks of UPSC CSE 2025 have been associated with various courses of VisionIAS.

Among them , 10 candidates in the Top 100 are students of the VisionIAS GS Foundation Classroom Course , marking a significant achievement and reflecting the strong conceptual foundation developed through the programme.

This outstanding presence among the top ranks reflects the impact of structured preparation, conceptual clarity, and sustained academic guidance that aspirants receive while preparing for the Civil Services Examination.
